name: CSIDA
summary: Cross-domain gesture dataset providing original and processed CSI together with gesture, environment, location, and person labels.

hardware.platform: Two laptops with one transmit and three receive antennas

settings.scenario: Six gestures at five physical room-position pairs across two rooms

formats: gesture, room, position, and user labels

standardization.notes: Gesture tasks use the 100 Hz time rule: each 1.8 s source clip is resampled from 1800 to 180 steps. All 114 subcarriers, 1 Tx, and 3 Rx links stay native by default; output is [T, S, Tx, Rx] per sample.
